_about: Match commentary lines, all original. broadcast/commentary.gd picks one when the match does something (the category). Each line's voice file is <category>_<nn>, nn its place in the list from 01, so add new lines at the end of a list and never reorder: see audio/commentary/README.md. Say ball and goal, never hail. {home}, {away} and {ground} in a line are filled in at play time; the voice plays the text between them as <id>_a, <id>_b and so on, with the names. "teams" is each club's name spelt the way it should sound, for the voice (file team_<club id>); captions show the real name. "grounds" does the same for each ground (file ground_<venue>), keyed by pitch/shinty_pitch.gd Venue.
